name: shell-assistant
title: Shell Assistant
description: The assistant's chat docked beside the page as a second card (the split view) — header actions, a removable context chip, a scrolling body and a composer slot.

meta.whenToUse: The workspace assistant on record and page screens: a small chat about what the person is looking at, opened from the global bar's Ask or ⌘J.
meta.whenNotToUse: The full chat page (Agents), phones (a PeekSheet composes the card's parts), or any data fetching — the host owns the chat.
